description: Claude's finished auto-mode turn lays out a decision under a heading line, with bulleted 'Option A:' / 'Option B —' rows, then asks 'Which one should I set up, option A or B?'. The model quotes the heading as question.subject and the two named rows as question.items, kept where the screen shows them, so the phone card says what is being decided and what each option is. Fictional.
capture:
